C0002 lacks significant biological support across all modalities: no RNA pathway, mutation, or CNV feature reaches FDR significance. Cross-modal consistency is weak (median ARI 0.421, PAC 0.811), and boundaries to other sets are near zero. No technical confounders explain the set, but the evidence is insufficient to define a distinct identity. No structural correction (split/merge) is supported because there is no positive evidence of internal substructure or a specific weak boundary with another set. Drop is the appropriate action given the absence of a defensible biological identity.

C0003 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (31/50 significant, large effect sizes) and significant CNV differences (9 continuous features, including lower chr20q and chr7p, and lower CDKN2A loss). BAP1 mutation depletion is suggestive but not FDR-significant. No technical confounders are significant, and internal structure is moderately stable (median ARI 0.603, PAC 0.529). The RNA and CNV signals provide a coherent biological identity, and the set is not a simple echo of stage/grade. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.
